MRDIR.Subtitle: Run the scene
MRDIR.MotifsHelp: A track for a specific moment. Press the active motif to return to the scene music.
MRDIR.TokenSizeHelp: Applied as you move the bar. With a floor marked it is the foreground size; distant ones shrink by perspective.
MRDIR.Opt_cover: Keep the background full-screen when panning
MRDIR.DepthScaleHelp: These options apply to every token in the scene, not only the cast.
MRDIR.NoFigures: This scene has no figures. Add them in the editor.
MRDIR.AlreadyPlaced: The whole cast is already in the scene.
MRDIR.HandoutsHelp: Show the document or image to all players.
MRDIR.DragHint: Right-click and drag to move the bar.
MRDIR.ActiveGM: Only the active GM can change audio and figures.
MRDIR.NoReading: This scene has no linked reading.
MRDIR.NoSound: Sound not found: check the scene settings.
MRDIR.MilestonesGM: Click a milestone to achieve it (tells the table if it is public). The eye decides whether it is revealed or stays secret.
MRDIR.PhrasePlaceholder: e.g. Footsteps sound behind the door
MRDIR.ClockHelpGM: Shift + click a segment: tell the table with a line of your own.
MRDIR.ClockPublicTip: Players can see this clock. Click to hide it.
MRDIR.ClockHiddenTip: Only the GM sees this clock. Click to show it to players.
MRDIR.ClockAnnounceOnTip: Tells the table when it advances. Click to turn off.
MRDIR.ClockAnnounceOffTip: Does not announce when it advances. Click to tell the table.
MRDIR.MsPublicTip: Revealed to the table when achieved. Click to keep it secret.
MRDIR.MsSecretTip: Secret even when achieved. Click to reveal it to the table.
MRDIR.Set.ShowBarHint: Only the GM sees it. Shortcut: Alt+B.
MRDIR.Set.BgHint: Turn it off to see only the buttons over the scene.
MRDIR.Set.FadeHint: 0 = automatic (the pack value, 3.5 s by default).
MRDIR.Set.EditorHint: Set up music, motifs, effects, figures, handouts and markers for each scene.
MRDIR.Tour.OfferTitle: Shall I show you the direction bar?
MRDIR.Tour.OfferText: There is a guided tutorial of a few minutes. You can repeat it from the bar mix menu or in Settings → Tours.
MRDIR.Ed.Title: MR- Dirección · Editor
MRDIR.Ed.MotifsHint: Tracks are assigned in the Global tab.
MRDIR.Ed.NoMotifs: No motifs yet: create them in Global.
MRDIR.Ed.Label: Label
MRDIR.Ed.NoBackground: This scene has no background image.
MRDIR.Ed.FloorHint: Drag the horizon line (eye height) and click the floor to mark standing points. Right-click a point to delete it. The lines show the height a figure would have.
MRDIR.Ed.ModeHint_horizon: A line at eye height. Fits almost any level view.
MRDIR.Ed.ModeHint_vanishing: Corridors, streets, rooms: mark the rectangle where the perspective ends and the corner lines fix the vanishing point.
MRDIR.Ed.ModeHint_none: Top-down view or map: figures do not change size.
MRDIR.Ed.NoneHint: No perspective: figures keep the same size wherever they are (the size set in the Figures bar). Use it for top-down maps.
MRDIR.Ed.VPHint: Drag the point to where the floor lines converge and click the floor to mark where people stand. With no points, Place spreads the cast along the rays.
MRDIR.Ed.VPHintNone: Click the image where the floor lines converge (the end of a corridor, the end of a street).
MRDIR.Ed.RefDraw: Mark a door or wall as reference
MRDIR.Ed.RefDrawing: Drag on the image to draw the rectangle.
MRDIR.Ed.RefHintNone: Optional: draw a rectangle over something of known size (the door at the end, a table…) so figures come out at their real scale. A door is about 2.1 m.
MRDIR.Ed.RefHint: A 1.75 m person at the rectangle’s base is exactly as tall as they should be (white lines). Size 360 in the bar is this scale.
MRDIR.Ed.RefHeightTip: Real height of the marked object (a door is about 2.1 m)
MRDIR.Ed.ExitDrawing: Drag on the image to draw the exit rectangle: where the perspective ends.
MRDIR.Ed.ExitHintNone: Draw the exit rectangle (where the corridor or street ends): the lines from the four corners of the image to its corners fix the vanishing point. Or just drag a point.
MRDIR.Ed.ExitHint: Each corner of the image goes to its corner of the rectangle; those lines cross at the vanishing point, which gives the horizon and the scale. Drag the corners to adjust it. Real height of the rectangle: ceiling ≈ 2.7 m, door ≈ 2.1 m.
MRDIR.Ed.MsPublic: Reveal to the table when achieved
MRDIR.Ed.ClockAnnounce: Tell the table when it advances
MRDIR.Ed.ClockPhrases: Lines on advance, one per line and per segment (the 1st on reaching 1…). A single line is always used.
MRDIR.Ed.NoScenes: There are no scenes in this world.
MRDIR.Ed.AutoDone: Auto-configured — music {m}, reading {r}, figures {f}. Please review.
MRDIR.NoAudioHint: no audio: click to assign one
MRDIR.AudioLocked: The browser still blocks audio: click the page and try again.
MRDIR.Pick.None: There are no sounds in your playlists: use “File…”.
MRDIR.NoActors: This scene has no placeable actors: check its figures in the editor.
